name: zzBH1_stance_ground

tests.name: there is a fixed datum to measure every skin against

detail.note: the Dog's own origin, held constant by G02. Relative to it is what the founder's 'copy Relay OG's ground contact' actually means.

tests.name: Relay OG was put back on the Dog, and it went back
every skin produced a costume whose bounds could be read
the Dog stood still for the whole run, so the skins are compared in one place

detail.note: THE CONTROL. A Dog that wandered between skins turns a ground-contact comparison into a comparison of two different bits of floor.

tests.name: every skin's lowest geometry meets the floor where Relay OG's does

detail.note: the founder's 'ground contact', and their 'root-pose cause'. Compared against RELAY OG rather than an invented absolute, because their sentence makes Relay OG the authority. A skin that is simply TALLER is not failed here -- height is reported separately.

tests.name: every costume is rooted exactly on the Dog, with no per-skin offset

detail.note: the costume is ATTACHED to the Dog, so this should be zero for every skin by construction. A non-zero value is a cosmetic offset of exactly the kind the founder asked not to be used as a fix.
